title: panicum creperum
intro: Panicum creperum, commonly known as Creeping Panicgrass, is a type of grass native to tropical and subtropical regions. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include several health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects. Its therapeutic actions include reducing fever, alleviating digestive issues, and providing relief from respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents of Creeping Panicgrass include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
